issues.description: Behavioral change: empty base_image fallback now defaults to python:3.12 instead of kfp default image
issues.detail: In pipeline.py, _set_base_image previously left base_image as empty string to let kfp pick its default image. Now it forces python:3.12 unconditionally, which changes runtime behavior for users relying on the kfp default. The comment above still says 'Use kfp default image' but the code no longer does that. This is a semantic regression hidden in a UI PR.

issues.description: Hardcoded 'python:3.12' duplicated in three places defeats the purpose of the constant
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE is defined in pipeline.py, but the same literal 'python:3.12' is repeated in Commands.ts (RPC failure fallback), CellMetadataEditor.tsx (exported constant), and the jinja template comment. If the backend default changes, the frontend will silently drift. Consider sourcing the frontend constant only via the RPC and removing the literal fallback or logging clearly when it is used.

issues.description: IMAGE button no longer shows whether a custom base image is set, regressing discoverability
issues.detail: The old UI used an Input field where users could see and edit the current base image inline. The replacement is a generic 'IMAGE' button that gives no visual indication of whether the step has an override. Users must open the dialog to see what is configured. Consider showing the current value (or a 'custom' badge) on the button itself.

issues.description: Button is disabled when stepName is empty, blocking base-image edit for unnamed steps that previously worked
issues.detail: The Input was previously always editable for cellType==='step'. The new Button is disabled unless stepName has length > 0. This silently removes the ability to set a base image before naming the step, which is a UX regression from the prior behavior and is not mentioned in the PR description.

issues.description: Inline style width:'5%' on the IMAGE button is likely wrong and will render inconsistently
issues.detail: The Button has style={{ width: '5%' }} inside a wrapper div with no defined width context, which will produce a tiny or unpredictable button. The label 'IMAGE' will likely overflow or wrap. Use a fixed min-width or remove the percent width.

issues.description: Local import of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside get_default_base_image RPC is unnecessary
issues.detail: The function imports DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside the function body even though pipeline is already imported elsewhere in the module. Move the import to the top of nb.py for consistency and to avoid per-call import overhead. Minor, but worth fixing while touching the file.

review.summary: The PR cleanly threads a default base image from the backend to the labextension UI, but it carries a hidden backend behavior change (pipeline.py now forces python:3.12 instead of falling back to the kfp default), and the new IMAGE button is a UX regression compared to the inline input it replaces (no visible value, disabled before step is named, suspect 5% width). The default-image literal is duplicated in three places, which weakens the single-source-of-truth intent. No P0 correctness or security issues found.
